name: Azure File Sync
short_description: Azure File Sync caches files from Azure Files on local Windows servers, giving on-premises users local performance while Azure Files remains the source of truth.

evidence.quote: Azure file syncs lets you cache files on a local server while keeping Azure files as the source of truth.
It works with Azure file sync for hybrid scenarios.
O Azure File Sync permite armazenar arquivos em cache em um servidor local,
